## Little Match

Little Match is the tiny, down-on-her-luck **unicorn match seller** glimpsed in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*’s *A Hearth’s Warming Tail* (season 6, episode 8; May 14, 2016). She appears **inside Twilight’s story about Snowfall Frost**, not as a newly established resident of present-day Ponyville. Her brief appearance is a visual nod to Hans Christian Andersen’s *The Little Match Girl*.

[![Little Match — episode still, Hasbro Studios/DHX Media](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp/images/e/e3/Little_Match_ID_S6E8.png/revision/latest?cb=20160518164353)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/File:Little_Match_ID_S6E8.png)

* **Look:** Small pale cream-yellow filly with a horn, warm golden mane, brown eyes and a humble, bundled-up match-seller appearance.
* **Name:** “Little Match” is a **community identification**, not a confirmed name spoken in the show or an established official character name. The [foal catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals) records her appearance and notes the *Little Match Girl* reference. Her reused character model resembles Featherweight’s; **they are not thereby the same pony**.
* **Voice and appearances:** No identifiable spoken line, credited voice actor, or verified second on-screen appearance. The episode was produced by [Hasbro Studios and DHX Media](https://www.intanibase.com/iad_entries/entry?shortID=37293). Fan retellings of Andersen’s story are separate continuities.

## Important moments

1. **A match seller in the winter street — “A Hearth’s Warming Tail” (S6E8).** During Snowfall Frost’s “Say Goodbye to the Holiday” sequence, the little filly briefly appears amid the wintry city, bringing Andersen’s vulnerable match seller into the episode’s *Christmas Carol*-inspired setting. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jJobc5VsK2s) (scene timestamp unavailable).

That is her **only verified character-specific scene**; adding further “important moments” would turn unrelated holiday-story events into invented actions by her.
